name: Mix With The Masters - Billie Eilish - Producing ‘Birds of a Feather’ ft. Finneas
original_name: Mix With The Masters - Billie Eilish - Producing ‘Birds of a Feather’ ft. Finneas
overview: After soaring to the top of the charts across the globe, this remarkable album track has evolved into one of Billie Eilish’s most successful songs to date. Explore the writing and production process behind ‘BIRDS OF A FEATHER’ and learn how Billie and Finneas pushed their sound into a bold new direction.
